Sync.//: Cloud sync. Leave Url as it is and the feature disappears from Settings, which is the right state for a fork of this repo. Fill both in to turn it on: create a Supabase project, run db/sync.sql in its SQL editor, then paste the project URL and its anon (publishable) key here. The anon key belongs in a public build — it grants nothing without a pairing code — but the project URL must ALSO be added to connect-src in index.html, or the browser blocks every request before it is made.
